description: Replay every failed message for one endpoint since a timestamp. Runs as a background task — follow it with svix_list_background_tasks. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/recover.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the replay window, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.

until.description: ISO-8601 end of the replay window. Defaults to now.

name: svix_recover_endpoint
title: Recover an endpoint's failed messages
